title: 2 men injured in late-night shooting in Dorchester, police say
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Two men were injured in a shooting at 31 Hancock St., Dorchester, late Friday night, according to Boston police.
Both victims suffered non-life-threatening injuries; one was hospitalized, and the other self-admitted for treatment.
No suspects or charges have been identified; the police investigation into the incident is ongoing.

title: Woman trapped, injured in second incident on MBTA Davis escalator this year
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: A woman was injured on an MBTA Davis Station escalator when her clothing got stuck, similar to a prior fatal incident.
A bystander pressed the emergency stop button to help free the woman, who was hospitalized for a hand injury.
The MBTA urged riders to use escalator safety practices, acknowledging the quick action of the assisting passenger.

title: 2 men arrested after allegedly stealing chain, wallet at knifepoint in Dorchester
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Deivi Yoander Sanchez Aguasvivas, 24, and Luis Miguel Ramirez-Astacio, 26, arrested for armed robbery in Dorchester.
The victim was robbed of a chain and wallet at knifepoint by suspects on a blue moped.
Aguasvivas was held without bail pending hearing; Ramirez-Astacio had an outstanding warrant for multiple charges.

title: It’s not too late to submit your idea for $2 million in Boston spending
author: Morgan Rousseau
bullets: Boston extends the deadline for participatory budgeting submissions to August 7, allowing residents input on $2 million in city funds.
Participatory budgeting empowers Boston residents to propose projects, which must be one-time investments within city authority.
Finalists will be chosen in community forums, with voting on proposals set for January 15 to February 15.

title: Watch: Ceddanne Rafaela hits home runs in back-to-back at-bats
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Ceddanne Rafaela hit back-to-back home runs for the Boston Red Sox against the Los Angeles Dodgers on Saturday.
Rafaela's first homer in the first inning was a 389-foot solo shot off Yoshinobu Yamamoto's pitch.
Rafaela's second homer tied the game in the third inning, marking his 14th of the season.

title: Red Sox reportedly attempted to acquire shortstop Elly De La Cruz, turned down by Reds
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Boston Red Sox made a substantial prospect-based offer to acquire shortstop Elly De La Cruz from the Cincinnati Reds.
The sides failed to agree on a deal, leaving Boston's search for a shortstop at the trade deadline ongoing.
Boston is cautious about including top prospect Franklin Arias in trades without a perfect-fit acquisition.

title: Drake Maye says his shoulder ‘feels great’ as Patriots training camp continues
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Drake Maye's shoulder, injured during the AFC Championship, is now fully recovered, he revealed during Patriots training camp.
Patriots have strengthened their offensive lineup, adding wide receiver A.J. Brown to support quarterback Drake Maye.
New England faces Seattle Seahawks in a Super Bowl LX rematch during Week 1 of the 2026-27 season.

title: If July’s stretch of dominance wasn’t enough, the Red Sox’ win Friday proved they’re plenty capable of a postseason run
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: The Boston Red Sox defeated the Los Angeles Dodgers 5-4 on Friday, showcasing their postseason potential.
Ceddanne Rafaela's key hit turned the game, while Jarren Duran and Andruw Monasterio contributed crucial RBIs.
Despite missing key players, the Red Sox have strengthened their lineup and solidified as playoff contenders.

title: Red Sox fend off Dodgers, 9-4, in grindy series opener
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Ceddanne Rafaela's go-ahead two-run homer secured a 9-4 Red Sox victory over the Dodgers in Los Angeles.
Brayan Bello pitched four scoreless innings in relief, helping Boston win their 21st game of July.
The Red Sox scored six runs in the final three innings, with five in the seventh, improving their playoff chances.

title: Gabe Jacas makes his Patriots debut and other takeaways from Day 7 of training camp
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Gabe Jacas, Patriots' 2026 second-round pick, made a limited debut in training camp after a knee procedure.
The Patriots defense recorded two interceptions against Drake Maye and Tommy Devito during Saturday's practice.
Undrafted rookie Tanner Arkin is gaining attention as a potential backup tight end for the Patriots.
